source: Addressables catalog (assets/aa/catalog.bin) shipped in APK + Il2CppDumper dump.cs
limitation: Item ScriptableObject instances are NOT shipped in the APK: 0 ScriptableObject objects in all local bundles (bin/Data + aa/Android). Item data lives in remote-only Addressables bundles (CDN https://ec2cdn.gacogames.com/v1/Android/). Per-item stats (sellPrice, baseRarity, maxRarity, baseStats, upgrade materials) therefore CANNOT be read statically from this APK. The injector must enumerate items at RUNTIME from the game's loaded database (e.g. ItemInRMDatabase.itemCanBeMade / itemInRMs) or by calling the game's own lookup. Asset names below are the item identities (Item.id is the asset filename in this project); classification is heuristic, see 'confidence'.

spawn_mechanism.note: SpawnItem(Vector3 pos, Item item, ItemInstance attribute, ...) is the exact entry point for an on-demand item dropper: pass the player position + an Item resolved from the runtime database. LootType: Item=0, Gold=1, Ruby=2.
